sloka: अथ राक्षससिंहस्य कृष्णान् कनकभूषणान्।शरैश्चतुर्भिः सौमित्रिर्विव्याध चतुरो हयान् ।। ६.९०.३९ ।।
transliteration: atha rākṣasasiṁhasya kṛṣṇān kanakabhūṣaṇān।śaraiścaturbhiḥ saumitrirvivyādha caturo hayān ।। 6.90.39 ।।

translations.english: Then Saumithri pierced with four shafts all the four black horses decked in gold, of the lion of Rakshasas (Indrajith) and finished them
